# teams_tenant_trusted_ip_address (Resource)

Manages the TenantTrustedIPAddress policy via New-CsTenantTrustedIPAddress / Get-CsTenantTrustedIPAddress / Set-CsTenantTrustedIPAddress / Remove-CsTenantTrustedIPAddress.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `ip_address` (String) Maps to the -IPAddress parameter.
- `mask_bits` (Number) Maps to the -MaskBits parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
